test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is a subject of the State List in the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Constitution** divides the** legislative powers between the Centre and the States**. The State List contains 61 subjects over which the State Legislatures have exclusive power to legislate.
 
• Agriculture is one of the subjects included in the State List. This means that the State Governments have the power to make laws and policies related to agriculture within their respective states.
 
• Banking is a subject that falls under the Union List, which means that the Central Government has the power to legislate on matters related to banking. However, cooperative banks and regional rural banks come under the purview of both the Centre and the States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ports are also a subject that falls under the Union List, which means that the Central Government has the power to legislate on matters related to ports. However, the State Governments can also make laws and policies related to minor ports within their respective states.
 
• Railways are a subject that falls under the Union List.
